integrity: The primary public full text was inspected at the model CDF/PDF/survival, UPHCT likelihood Eq. (3.1), log-likelihood Eq. (3.2), score Eq. (3.3), the numerical-optimization description, and the real-data profile-likelihood claims. The original 2016 bounded-support model and a distinct finite-support MLE-boundary paper were compared. The existence criterion is derived directly from the published likelihood and replayed in the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies finite-MLE existence but does not prove uniqueness when a finite maximizer exists.
The boundary-region probability is quantified only for the complete-data special case, not for every censoring design.
The result does not dispute the finite profile maxima shown for the three empirical datasets in the source.
title: Exact boundary criterion for the one-parameter UPHCT likelihood
